summary.verdict_rationale: The DELISTED_BRIDGE_COVERAGE kill condition is the blocking defect. The identity store's RESOLVED, active=1 CIK bridge reaches only 469 of 1,236 delisted symbols (37.94% coverage), far below the frozen threshold of 85.00%. The false-match rate on the bridged delisted symbols was not measured (hand-checked sample size = 0). The kill condition requires BOTH coverage >= 0.85 AND measured false-match rate <= 0.02 with confidence interval. Neither requirement is satisfied.
summary.bridge_analysis: The identity store (historical_identity.sqlite) contains 1895 total securities from Norgate. The cik_map table has 1919 total mappings across 6 tiers. For delisted symbols (1236 total), available mappings are: Tier 3 (65, method: sec_filing_date_overlapping_ticker, RESOLVED), Tier 4 (404, method: legal_name_effective_date_overlap, RESOLVED), Tier 6 (778, method: unresolved_manual_review, status mixed RESOLVED/UNRESOLVED/AMBIGUOUS). Only Tier 3-resolved reaches 65 delisted symbols (5.26% coverage). Tier 4 (legal name overlaps) is tier 4, not tier 3, and would improve to 469 total (37.94%). Tier 6 mappings are mostly unresolved and lack confidence. No tier 1-2 mappings exist for delisted symbols.
summary.recommended_path_forward: To rescue this certification, source an external delisted symbol to CIK bridge with measured false-match rate. Lead 1: SEC Fails-to-Deliver files (CUSIP+SYMBOL at 99.8% coverage, need CUSIP↔CIK path). Lead 2: Norgate company name lookup with measured false-match rate on hand-checked sample (currently unvetted). Lead 3: SEC filing-date overlaps in tier 4 could be promoted if false-match audited.
